patch_description: This version keeps the layered 26-circle construction but adds an analytic Jacobian for all wall and pairwise separation constraints. This makes SLSQP substantially more efficient and permits a broader deterministic multistart search within the time budget. It explores rectangular, staggered, and triangular-like layered seeds with small asymmetric perturbations, then applies a final global radius scaling certificate to guarantee containment and non-overlap despite optimizer tolerances.
